classifications.rationale: The President requests that the Commission conduct fact-finding investigations and submit reports by specified deadlines. The actor is the Commission; the action is an investigative and reporting assignment concerning GSP impacts; and the segment neither presently changes GSP treatment nor dictates a later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: I hereby request the Commission, pursuant to section 332(g) of the Tariff Act of 1930 to conduct investigations and report the results
